query:
-- Todos os registros do Galão 1 com status
SELECT id, client_name, liters, ROUND(liters/100, 2) as liters_L, payment_status, created_at
FROM fuel_records
WHERE gallon_number = 1
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 25;

-- Verificar se há registros com status 'cancelled' em qualquer galão
SELECT gallon_number, payment_status, COUNT(*) as qtd, SUM(liters) as total_liters
FROM fuel_records
GROUP BY gallon_number, payment_status
ORDER BY gallon_number, payment_status;
